traps: there is no compose file: PostgreSQL and Redis are started by docker run targets of the Makefile, and the app finds them through DB_HOST and REDIS_HOST in .env.example
MySQL is an alternative selected by DB_TYPE (pgx or mysql) in the same line, with the driver github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql in go.mod
data access is sqlx over pgx and the MySQL driver, not an ORM; the SQL migrations under platform/migrations run with the external migrate tool
testify is used only by the two _test.go files in pkg/routes; go.mod has no test scope
the swagger packages generate API documentation and are not counted as frameworks here
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
